mentions.name: Abbox
mentions.description: Abbox is a tool being built by elchuzade (Kamran Elchuzade) to help engineers focus longer on tasks without being interrupted by non-technical people making small website requests.
mentions.problem: Engineers are constantly interrupted by small non-technical requests (e.g., "change this h1 to h2", "add tracking to share button", "why can't the customer play the video", "the styles don't match figma"), and it's hard to put it all together because every department has its own needs and opinions about the website.
mentions.audience: Engineers who get distracted by small requests from non-technical people/departments.
mentions.author: elchuzade

requests.evidence: If you are engineer who also gets distracted I would love to hear your opinion and feedback.
